تأسست جمعية مناصرة فلسطين عام 1423 هـ ال: The Palestine Advocacy Association was established in 1423 AH الموافق to 2002 AD under license No. 50/2002 issued by the Ministry of Social Development. It is a voluntary non-profit civil association founded by a group of dedicated supporters of the Palestinian cause who strive to keep Palestine present in people’s minds and hearts. The association also works to spread awareness among all segments of society in Bahrain about the importance of this cause, its central role for the Arab and Islamic nations, and supporting Palestine and its people through all legitimate means.
